steps.name: Ink Spirit
steps.text: Gkhaa—!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Is it just me or there are fewer of them?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: It does look that way, and they don't seem that scary any more.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Could they have forgotten about us?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Day after day, year after year, all that they ever do is attack the village for naught... it's wretched, and heartwrenching!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: How would you know? They don't talk—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: They—I suppose they just might be able to speak.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: What? The head priest always said we must forever be compassionate. If that really is the case, then we are in quite a pickle...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: But if this is really just a painting...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Maybe we've already found the right place.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I should've figured this out sooner. Damn it, Nian... She didn't tell us about this on purpose...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: She's probably worried we'd let something slip that would tip Dusk off and let her get away.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Would someone that powerful even run? To be honest with you, I'm a little scared of her...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Let's not talk about how all of this works for now. She's keeping us live humans hostage in this little world she created for herself. What's this supposed to mean?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Anything we eat might as well be real, and not only that, the people here can actually hold a conversation. Is this supposed to mean anything?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: If she's able to do all this with just Arts, then this sister of Nian's—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: You're right about that... I've seen lots of weird Originium Arts before, but this is maybe a little too out there.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My... Never in a thousand moons would I have imagined the person you are looking for could be so... extraordinary.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Is that so? Here I was thinking that, of all the places I've visited, this P'o-shan has to be one of the simplest, most unassuming towns.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Where have you been...?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Why, I could go all morning about this.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: During my travels, I have come across many an odd character. I have met someone who would use ale as a blade and betake herself like lightning. I have also seen someone fight with the most peculiar style, able to swim up a waterfall.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I have met one so sagacious, he could write a poem in eight steps. Alas, he offended the wrong men, and practically had to bring with him his own coffin to his final audience with his liege.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I have seen the famed Boulder of Pei-Hsüan. According to legend, in eras past, the boulder sprang up from the ground, suspending in midair when an emperor of the past ascended to his throne.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: At first, it was thought to portend the country's prosperous future under his rule, but it was also thought to mean he had a heavy load to bear, and was thus seen as an omen by many.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I have visited a mountain that scraped the skies, where, amidst the clusters of Originium left behind by Catastrophes, there stood solemnly a towering pine tree, reaching upwards, as though splitting the sea of clouds in twain.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I have seen many a blade piercing chessboards, books sauteed in woks. I have also met a woman of Yan performing the most extraordinary feat, forging a city all on her own. Yet, strangely, it was hazy in appearance, and she would only allow us to view the city from afar, not in its vicinity.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I would be remiss to forget the Yan emperor's close friend from faraway lands. He told the Lung of his journey to the west, and of the countless towns and cities his travels took him.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Each and every time he spoke, I could see the townscapes before my eyes!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: —Anyway, I know a thing or two because I've seen a thing or two.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Uhh, I know of this Boulder of Pei-Hsüan. I was under the impression it was destroyed years ago during a Catastrophe?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Exactly the one. I saw it float with my own eyes—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: How many years ago was that?!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I just want to make sure. The person you speak of... That's her sister?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: That's right.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: How is their relationship...?

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Oh~ Getting right to the meat of it.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Could it be the sisters are not on the best of terms?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Remember the thing I showed you? Nian gave me that. At first, I thought she gave it to us to prove our identities to Dusk...

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Ohh, the fascinating little trinket? What is its purpose, then?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: No idea...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Allow me? Oh, have you shown this to the storyteller?

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Hm, has he seen it already? Did... Did he say anything about it?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: He said he's never seen it.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I think... we should still have him take a look.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Err, if I may, there is actually one other thing that has left me quite perplexed...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Well, I mean, my benefactor, you saw me take on one of the fiends, did you not?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Oh... You mean how it took you forever and a half just to get away from one of the Ink Spirits?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Precisely!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I saw it too, but why that all of a sudden?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Well... I am but a defenseless layman in the martial arts. Be that as it may, I cracked an entire canister of whoop-ass on the fiend. Surely you too must find that strange!

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Uh... You call that a can of whoop-ass?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —*Cough* *cough*! Umm, well, I have a few tricks up my sleeve—Now, I implore you, don't get the wrong idea. It's not that I don't want to do my part in our battle against the monsters. I just have my reasons—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: So, your point is...?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Um, my benefactor, certainly you believe me?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: I certainly believe you not. You may be good at tricking people, but definitely not me. If I couldn't figure this much out, I wouldn't be any use out here on a mission.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: Oh, I had my doubts about that too! I saw Master Nothing dart away with the little girl on his back in no time and without a breaking a sweat. I am certain he is no less formidable than my fellow disciples back at the temple!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: H-Haha, please, don't give me that look. I'm trying my best now, am I not?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Right! It's getting late! Let's make our way to the storyteller and check on him! He is ill, is he not?

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: *cough*... Are you here for my tales? My apologies, but I'm afraid I won't have any stories to tell today with the shape I'm in.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Please, you must get more rest. Just leave everything to us.

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: You need not worry. I'm fine... *cough*... This is the first time we've met, is it not? Where are you from, my friends?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Why, uh... I'm from quite far away. I'm merely passing through, but with all the men in the village singing the praises of your storytelling, I had to come hear for myself!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But if you're indisposed, then we could... pay you a visit another day. Yes, we shall return, haha.

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: A moment, please. *cough* I cannot fault you for not knowing, but we rarely have any visitors here in P'o-shan, and I am not one to turn away those who wish to hear my stories.

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: I have a guest room in my garden. Perhaps you would be so kind as to stay the night?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Are you feeling okay?

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: I'm not sure myself. It might just be a cold... though it certainly doesn't seem that way. The doctor wasn't sure of the cause either. I suppose it's a sign my body's gotten weaker because I've been neglecting my training. Please, don't pay it any mind.

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: I-Ch'uan, take them there.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Of course.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Well... We'll take you up on the offer, then.

steps.name: Villager
steps.text: Please, this way.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Why, this is peculiar. I walked out of this very house in the morning and went on a stroll, and now I'm being invited to stay here anew... This really makes no sense!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Well, my benefactors...

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Nothing.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Uh... Haha... *Ahem*. I am not getting out of this one, am I? I understand.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Well... Where should I begin...? After all, I've been deceiving the two of you right from the start.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: That I've more or less figured out.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Please accept my apologies.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: You sure know how to switch up your attitude quick, don't you? Oh well, whatever. I understand. You can't just completely trust a person you come across out in the wastes.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: You have my thanks.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Are you from Kou-wu?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: No... my hometown is farther north. Just your regular small town.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I had resigned myself to live a normal, uninteresting life as a plowboy. That summer, a few men from the cities came to our town, led by a fine, magnificent lady. She said I was the one they sought.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I was just thirteen at the time. They brought me to Kou-wu to a martial arts school, the Liens, and she was its master.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: That's how I met my master, and all there was to it. I had room and board, and when I had the time, I could help out at construction sites and earn some coin to send to my family back home.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I remained diligent over the past ten years, but never once did I think my master did me a favor for taking me in.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I made it a point to rely on none but myself. I would rather go without a meal than be looked down upon by my master.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But... she was getting on in years. I once thought her formidable, matchless, even. But she was seriously ill. Couldn't even get a decent night's sleep.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: That was when I came to realize I could stay there no longer. All my fellow disciples had left, and it was my time to do so as well.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But... last year, I killed someone by accident. Someone whom I should not have killed.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I thought it was a friendly match between dojos. It wasn't until much later that I found out the man had sold his life. He was meant to die by my hands.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: The Lien style's reputation was already on its last legs, but they wanted to defame our name nonetheless. It was all a ploy to bring my master to swallow her pride and get her down on her knees.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —And then—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My master, her hair white as ash and braided just like my mother's, stood before all and spilled her own blood as the rules dictated!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: ...My goodness!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: 'Rules!' It's murder, I tell you!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I brought my unconscious master back, but they had our school completely surrounded.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: I could not call for an ambulance, let alone my fellow disciples!

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: All I could do was watch her body turn cold. Their men stood outside, unmoving until they saw my poor master buried.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My master left me with this fan. I don't have the courage to use it, and certainly not the moves she taught me.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: The school was lost, and I had no way to get in touch with my fellow disciples. So I concealed my identity, masquerading as a fortune teller, a Messenger.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: But no matter the case, I did whatever it took to leave that city, and I will make my way to the capital or Lungmen, wherever. The more people there, the better—

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: —Then, one day, I shall return to Kou-wu City and make things right.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: That is the story... my benefactor, Kroos, what you said on the day of the rescue. You had the right of it.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: All those years I spent in Kou-wu City... I wasted.

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: I heard stories of the Yan martial artists' sense of honor, yet never would I have imagined such a tale...

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: So it wasn't just a traffic accident...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Correct... the villains had men in every corner of Kou-wu City! I watched in hiding from a nearby village, but luck was not on my side. In the end, my only choice was to find myself a car and skip town—

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: Your master had gone that far, and they still wouldn't leave you alone?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: Leave me alone?

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: If they had their minds set on leaving anyone alone, I doubt they would bend the rules to kill!

steps.name: Saga
steps.text: To think that there are rules this rotten and unreasonable... 'Twould seem there is yet much for me to learn about this world.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Alright then... This all sounds like something out of a martial arts novel, but well... I believe you.

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: *sobs*, my benefactor! Your reason moves me! As your stalwart underling, rest assured I'll do all that it takes to return the favor, come hell or high water!

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: *Sigh*...

steps.name: Mr. Nothing
steps.text: My benefactor... you wouldn't think I'm still lying, would you?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Well, you'd be one hell of a liar if that was a lie.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Please, come in.

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: *cough*... Full glad am I to find you here, my guests. I thought you would be resting in your room. Could you find our hospitality wanting, perchance...?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Uh, no, not at all. We are just talking about something among ourselves.

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: *cough*, I see... Pray accept my humblest apologies for interrupting. I merely wished to caution you against visiting Mt. Hung-tung. It is abound with monsters ahead of the New Year.

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Okay, thanks for the reminder.

steps.name: Storyteller
steps.text: Most certainly. I shall take my leave now... *cough*—

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: Hope you get better soon.

steps.name: Kroos
steps.text: What's up?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: The Umbrella-Boiler guy... You think he's from inside the painting?

steps.name: Lava
steps.text: If even this is part of the painting... what about us?
